title: UkviVisaUpdateInboundV1
description: Inbound UKVI visa status update received from UKVI's SMS or electronic notification channel and submitted via POST /api/v1/regulatory/ukvi/visa-updates. Covers visa grants, refusals, curtailments, and expirations.

casReference.description: UKVI-assigned CAS reference number identifying the sponsored student.

statusCode.description: UKVI visa status code. Common values: 'granted' (visa granted), 'refused' (visa refused), 'curtailed' (leave curtailed), 'expired' (visa expired), 'cancelled' (visa cancelled).

effectiveDate.description: Date from which the new status is effective (YYYY-MM-DD).

rawPayload.description: Raw UKVI notification payload for audit purposes. Stored as-is; not validated.

idempotencyKey.description: UKVI-provided transaction reference. Duplicate submissions with the same key are rejected. Use the UKVI notification reference number.
